Institutional ETF outflows suggest professional managers are reducing risk exposure. BlackRock and Fidelity were among the biggest buyers of BTC via ETFs since the launch in January 2024, and when those institutions pull back, the selling pressure is real. Combined with negative funding in derivatives, the signal is broad risk aversion.

Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are also weighing on sentiment: during periods of stress, investors tend to rotate into “safer” assets like the U.S. dollar and Treasuries. Quarter-end on Friday could amplify institutional redemptions as funds close positions for reporting.
